citations.quote:
It’s # 1 after the fear of death!

I’m talking about speaking on camera.

observation.text: The text starts with a bold statement intended to capture attention: 'It’s # 1 after the fear of death!', followed by an explanation of the topic being introduced.

citations.quote: As recently as 2022, I had a severe fear of being on camera. But I knew that if I wanted to grow my business, I had to overcome it. And I did, with the help of mentors, coaches, and a lot of uncomfortable practice.

summary.text: The author had a severe fear of being on camera as recently as 2022 but overcame it with the help of mentors, coaches, and a lot of uncomfortable practice.

citations.quote: Today, filming yourself is a mandatory part of my coaching programme for agents too.

summary.text: Filming oneself is a mandatory part of the author's coaching program for agents.

citations.quote: Because your first videos don’t need to be good. They just need to exist.

summary.text: Your first videos don’t need to be good. They just need to exist.
